blocks.head: alt UserX is not near a device and the device exists
alt UserX is near the device
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt Existing distinct users UserX and UserY
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device and ImmediateRelayUser is near the device
alt The cloud command L is being delivered for the device, CachingRelayUser is near the device, and CachingRelayUser has no cached command
alt CachingRelayUser is near the device and has cached command L
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by share and UserY
alt Processing a proxy command containing auth encrypted with the secret, followed by revoke and UserY

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | ('key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ..) , ...) > < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ....) > $ UserX 'shareAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY) 
= < cloudA | ('key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ..) , ...) > < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ....) > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) .

eq < cloudA | ('key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX , UserY , ..) , ...) , ....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , .....) > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' cloudA | (deviceB ; UserY) 
= < cloudA | ('key' : 'secret' , deviceB : ('trusted' : (UserX) , ...) , ....) > < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , .....) > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' RelayUser | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) .

eq < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < ImmediateRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > $ RelayUser 'forwardCommand' deviceB | (L) 
= < RelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > < ImmediateRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , ...) > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (L) .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'proxyCommand' CachingRelayUser | (deviceB ; L) 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ..) > .

eq < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : L , ..) > 
= < CachingRelayUser | ('near' : deviceB , 'cachedCommand' : nils , ..) > $ CachingRelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (L) .

eq < deviceB | ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ..) > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'share' ; UserY) 
= < deviceB | ('trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('trusted' : (TrustedUsers , UserY) , ..) > $ RelayUser 'proxyCommand' deviceB | (deviceB ; encrypt('auth', 'secret') ; 'revoke' ; UserY) 
= < deviceB | ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > .
